final: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT translink, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM advancedbehavior GROUP BY translink), total_counts AS (SELECT SUM(group_count) AS total_count FROM group_counts), shares AS (SELECT g.group_count, CAST(g.group_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share FROM group_counts AS g JOIN total_counts AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT s.group_count, s.share, s.share - a.mean_share AS difference FROM shares AS s JOIN average_share AS a ON a.mean_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.mean_share) SELECT AVG(group_count) AS average_group_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(difference) AS average_difference FROM kept
